newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission to adopt paper on green taxes and levies.
newsitem.headline: Commission to adopt paper on green taxes and levies.

text.p: The European Commission is due to adopt a communication on Wednesday on its legal thinking about member states' use of environmental taxes and charges in national policy, a Commission official said.
The stated aim of the proposal, backed by Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti and his environment counterpart Ritt Bjerregaard, is to clarify the legal basis for such measures.

A draft of the paper charts the increased use of charges and levies, instruments it describes as an appropriate means to enforce the "polluter-pays principle" by including the environmental costs of a product or service into its price.

Areas which the communication is intended to make clearer include the definition of a levy's environmental objectives, their implications for customs duties, internal taxation, indirect taxation, state aids and quantitative restrictions.
It also sets out certain notification requirements.

"The communication is expected to contribute to the aim of ensuring a balanced and efficient use of the environmental taxes and charges at member state, regional or local level, and a transparent assessment by the Commission," a draft of the paper said.
